{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Create a copy to work with
df = trial_df.copy()

# Remove rows with sentinel value -999.0 in baseline
# This is a common practice when the value indicates missing or invalid data
# We'll keep only rows where baseline is not -999.0
valid_df = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0]

# Check the new shape
print('Original shape:', df.shape)
print('Valid shape (excluding -999.0):', valid_df.shape)
print('\n')

# Check if the removal affects the balance between arms
print('Arm distribution in valid data:')
print(valid_df['arm'].value_counts())
print('\n')

# Check if the removal affects the severity distribution
print('Severity distribution in valid data:')
print(valid_df['severity'].value_counts())
print('\n')

# Check if the removal affects the sex distribution
print('Sex distribution in valid data:')
print(valid_df['sex'].value_counts())
print('\n')

# Check if the removal affects the assay_batch distribution
print('Assay_batch distribution in valid data:')
print(valid_df['assay_batch'].value_counts())"}
